terms.note: Use ‘biais cognitif’ for the general decision-science concept; ‘distorsion cognitive’ belongs mainly to CBT contexts.
Use ‘biais d’ancrage’ for the named bias and ‘effet d’ancrage’ when describing the phenomenon.
Keep the noun concise; explain it in plain language when first introduced to a broad audience.
Prefer the shorter form in navigation and the longer form when clarity matters.
‘Réduction des biais’ is more transparent for general readers; ‘débiaisage’ may be retained in technical contexts.
Avoid the English false friend ‘évidence’ when referring to research support.
Use action-oriented wording rather than a literal technical calque where possible.
